tasks.label: Start Streamlit
tasks.command: pgrep -f 'streamlit run streamlit_app.py' > /dev/null || nohup .venv/bin/streamlit run streamlit_app.py --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.port 8501 --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false --browser.gatherUsageStats false > /tmp/streamlit.log 2>&1 &
